phenomenon.name: Quantum Vacuum State & Zero-Point Energy
phenomenon.description: The lowest-energy state of quantum fields, containing non-zero energy (zero-point energy) and virtual particle fluctuations. In QFT, 'empty space' is not nothing—it is a dynamic field configuration with measurable physical consequences.

core_physics.predictive_accuracy: ~10 decimal places for certain observables (g-2, Lamb shift)
core_physics.status: Most predictive theory in physics (empirically verified)

scalar_field.name: Higgs field
scalar_field.function: Gives mass to electroweak gauge bosons and fermions via Yukawa couplings
scalar_field.metaphor: Molasses (Tong); caveat: implies friction, which is incorrect

zero_point_energy.description: Baseline energy of quantum harmonic oscillators at ground state; E = (1/2)ℏω per mode
zero_point_energy.physical_manifestation: Casimir effect, Lamb shift, spontaneous emission
zero_point_energy.cosmological_problem: Predicts ~10^120 times observed dark energy density (vacuum catastrophe)

virtual_particles.description: Particle-antiparticle pairs that briefly borrow energy from vacuum via ΔE·Δt ~ ℏ/2
virtual_particles.ontological_status: Heuristic / calculational tool in perturbation theory; literal existence debated
virtual_particles.alternative_interpretation: Vacuum correlations / field fluctuations; not literal particles popping in and out

matter_asymmetry.description: Visible universe = ~1 particle per 10^9 that survived matter-antimatter annihilation
matter_asymmetry.status: Observed but unexplained; Sakharov conditions necessary but insufficient

claims: QFT is the most predictive theory in physics
Vacuum is not empty; contains zero-point energy
12 matter fields + 3 force fields + Higgs constitute the Standard Model
Higgs gives mass via interaction, not friction
Unstable nothing gives rise to elementary particles 'period, end of debate'
Krauss's 'universe from nothing' resolves the cosmological question
philosophical_speculation.verdict: Philosophical interpretation presented as settled science; equivocation on 'nothing'
issues: Krauss's 'nothing' = quantum vacuum with fields and laws ≠ philosophical nothingness
Cosmogony mechanism (quantum fluctuation → universe) requires pre-existing spacetime/field structure
'Why is there something rather than nothing?' remains open; not 'end of debate'

claims: Nothingness is a substrate your brain attaches to in order to 'receive' consciousness
unsupported_mysticism.verdict: Pseudoscientific; no basis in QFT or neuroscience
unsupported_mysticism.analysis: Conflates vacuum state with consciousness substrate; no mechanism proposed; no empirical test; possibly references Penrose-Hameroff Orch-OR or Bohm's implicate order without attribution

ac_application.description: A_c applied to distinguish testable vacuum physics from untestable metaphysical claims
ac_application.formula: A_c(vacuum_claim) = T_testable · E_empirical + (1 - T_testable) · P_falsifiability · C_coherence

testability.description: Fraction of claim derivable from QFT Lagrangian with measurable predictions

empirical_support.description: Bayesian evidence ratio for claim vs. null hypothesis

falsifiability_penalty.description: Penalty for claims that evade falsification by construction
falsifiability_penalty.note: P = 0 for unfalsifiable claims; P = 1 for cris falsifiable predictions

internal_coherence.description: Logical consistency with established physics framework

anomaly_classification.severity: Medium - requires careful demarcation between physics and metaphysics
anomaly_classification.classification_rationale: The vacuum state is physically real and measurable, but its interpretation ('nothing' vs. 'something') is philosophical. A_c must separate empirical content from interpretational overlay.

pre_transition_state_indicators.description: Vacuum state as 'pre-particle' configuration; cosmogony as transition from symmetric vacuum to broken-symmetry matter-dominated universe
indicators: Vacuum energy density (~10^-9 J/m³ observed) vs. QFT prediction (~10^113 J/m³): 120 orders of magnitude discrepancy = unresolved phase transition
Matter-antimatter asymmetry: universe selected one outcome from symmetric vacuum; mechanism unknown
Electroweak symmetry breaking: Higgs field transitioned from symmetric vacuum to broken phase ~10^-12 s after Big Bang
pre_transition_state_indicators.transition_hypothesis: The vacuum may be a metastable state (false vacuum); decay to true vacuum would be catastrophic phase transition. Current vacuum may be 'pre-transition' relative to deeper ground state.

connections.vacuum_view: Vacuum state as wavefunction of the field; measurement collapses to particle state
Vacuum branches into all possible particle configurations; no collapse
Vacuum state represents agent's betting odds about field measurements; not objective reality
Vacuum evolution as one consistent history among many; decoherence selects classical branches

theoretical_clusters.relevance: Critical - vacuum ontology varies dramatically by interpretation

theoretical_clusters.connection: Vacuum in quantum gravity may not be a fixed background; spacetime itself emergent from quantum vacuum (e.g., causal set theory, loop quantum gravity)
Vacuum entanglement entropy (Bekenstein-Hawking, Ryu-Takayanagi); vacuum as maximally entangled state in QFT; complexity of vacuum state in holography
IIT requires integrated information (Φ > 0); vacuum has no integrated information by definition (no causal structure). 'Consciousness from vacuum' is formally impossible under IIT.
theoretical_clusters.relevance: Critical - provides formal refutation of article's mysticism claim

technical_risks.risk: A_c demarcation may be perceived as philosophical gatekeeping rather than scientific tool
technical_risks.mitigation: Emphasize that A_c scores are dynamic; claims can move layers as evidence accumulates

technical_risks.risk: Popular science content is too noisy for reliable NLP-SNN classification
technical_risks.mitigation: Focus on peer-reviewed abstracts first; expand to pop-sci only after validation

scientific_risks.risk: Vacuum energy / cosmological constant problem may be resolved by new physics (e.g., string theory, causal set theory), rendering current A_c scoring obsolete
scientific_risks.mitigation: A_c framework is designed to evolve; new physics simply moves claims from Layer 2 to Layer 1

scientific_risks.risk: Consciousness-vacuum claims may gain unexpected empirical support (e.g., quantum effects in microtubules)
scientific_risks.mitigation: A_c would update accordingly; current 0.0 score reflects current evidence, not permanent dismissal

open_questions: Why does QFT predict vacuum energy ~10^120 times larger than observed? (Cosmological constant problem)
What is the ontological status of virtual particles? (Correlation effects vs. literal particles)
Can the 'universe from nothing' be made mathematically rigorous without pre-existing structure?
Does the vacuum have a temperature? (Unruh effect, Hawking radiation suggest yes for accelerated observers)
Is the Higgs vacuum truly metastable? (Current calculations suggest lifetime >> universe age, but uncertainties remain)
Can A_c formalism be generalized to other physics-metaphysics boundaries (e.g., multiverse, string theory landscape)?
